contract: Compare QuickTime PCM packet grouping and cross-track delivery order with the MOV demuxer with +noparse+nofillin, reading each packet through the compatibility payload reader.
Each packet folds stream index, PTS and DTS with their presence bits and raw values, duration, physical position, flags, size and every payload byte in delivery order.
Fold a terminal record for EOF or refusal.
Input loading and schedule parsing precede the operation. Both sides open, consume and release their readers inside it.

open_deviations.reading: Version 0 descriptions outside the QuickTime PCM layout
open_deviations.clause: Apple QuickTime File Format ‘Sound sample description version 0 (stsd)’ and ‘Sound sample data’: version 0 describes raw 8-bit offset-binary or twos 16-bit two’s complement PCM with one or two channels
open_deviations.reference: publishes PCM for wider layouts and other encodings, including 16-, 24- and 32-bit sowt and 8-, 24- and 32-bit twos
open_deviations.compat: compat::mov::pcm extended_version_zero_pcm would accept wider layouts as the demuxer does

open_deviations.reading: Zero channels in a version 0 description
open_deviations.clause: Apple QuickTime File Format ‘Sound sample description version 0 (stsd)’ and ‘Sound sample data’: the supported channel counts are 1 and 2
open_deviations.reference: reports a zero channel count and reads 16 payload bytes

open_deviations.reading: Compressed-audio fields carried in a version 0 PCM entry
open_deviations.clause: Apple QuickTime File Format ‘Sound sample description version 0 (stsd)’ and ‘Sound sample data’ requires compression ID zero; Apple QuickTime File Format ‘Sound sample description version 1 (stsd)’ uses -2 for redefined sample tables
open_deviations.candidate: refuses version 0 compression ID -2 with packet size 7

open_deviations.reading: A sample that ends inside a PCM frame
open_deviations.clause: Apple QuickTime File Format ‘Sound sample description version 0 (stsd)’ and ‘Sound sample data’ defines the sample width and interleaved layout; Apple QuickTime File Format ‘Sound sample description version 1 (stsd)’ defines one frame as one sample from each channel; ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 §8.7.3.2.2 fixes each sample extent
open_deviations.candidate: refuses the one-byte sample in a 16-bit mono track
open_deviations.reference: reads a full configured width and emits 32 PCM bytes from the file
open_deviations.compat: compat::mov::pcm configured_width_reads would use the configured width in place of the source sample extent

open_deviations.clause: Apple QuickTime File Format ‘Sound sample description version 1 (stsd)’ and Apple QuickTime File Format ‘Sound sample description version 2 (stsd)’ extend the layout. The version 0 PCM API only admits the version 0 layout
open_deviations.candidate: refuses the two versions as unsupported by the PCM reader or packet profile
open_deviations.reference: opens both and reads 32 bytes of PCM per case
open_deviations.compat: compat::mov::pcm extended_sound_descriptions would admit uncompressed versions 1 and 2

open_deviations.reading: Version 0 metadata and a fractional rate in the integer-clock packet profile
open_deviations.clause: Apple QuickTime File Format ‘Sound sample description version 0 (stsd)’ and ‘Sound sample data’: sample rate is unsigned 16.16, and the Vendor field is set to zero. PcmPacketCursor documents its zero revision and vendor and integral-clock preconditions
open_deviations.candidate: refuses revision 37 and vendor test before projecting the 48000.5 Hz clock
open_deviations.reference: reports integer 48000 Hz and reads 32 bytes as PCM
open_deviations.compat: compat::mov::pcm rounded_sound_rate would admit this metadata and expose the demux integer rate
